topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The city's got a way of changing its face, and so does the joint I work for. Heard the word today, about Jimmy getting switched over to accounting. Always knew the kid had a knack for numbers, more than he did for the paint mixer. Guess you could say, it was coming. Not a bad move, considering the lay of the land. Got a new view, maybe a shot at seeing how the other side operates. Change of scenery does a man good, especially when it means leaving behind the dusty hoses and the chemical smells for a desk with a view and a more stable chair. Things are looking up for Jimmy, and I'll be damned if that doesn't give this city a brighter shade of gray.
